item.title: Are you happy?
item.description: The concept of happiness is alien to me. I don’t quite know what a reasonably smart, happy person looks like and thus cannot myself pursue and aspire to a “state of happiness”. I can, however, understand what it means to be content and grateful for one’s position in life. These feelings are materially different from a state of happiness because they are both temporary and subject to self-persuasion, as well as independent from external validation.
